title: How he got the name Don Albert, and Big Jim
summary: Albert chose the shorter name Don Albert; Floyd's men called him Don and Big Jim.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: And it's, it's, you already had that name, Don Albert. They were calling you Don before you organized your band?

Yes, and that's how I acquired the name. And as I told you before, I, of course, my wife disagrees with me. She seemed to think that the Dominic would have been as good or better name. But I thought by having a shorter name that it would be better just to say Don Albert. Which to some people are confusing. A lot of people don't know that Don Albert is Don Albert Dominic. See, they come to San Antonio looking for Albert Dominic in the form book and actually it's Don Albert. So they don't, they're confused.
Yeah, you wrote me that the guys in Troy Floyd's band called you Don.
I called me Don and Jim. Jim. I don't know whether Jim, I never will understand how Jim, Big Jim.
